preamble.summary: Psalm 93 (MT) / Psalm 92 (LXX) is the first of the 'YHWH reigns' (YHWH malak) enthronement psalms (93, 95–99) — declaring divine-kingship over the cosmic-chaos-waters. The psalm's opening 'the LORD reigns; he is robed in majesty' and closing 'holiness befits your house, O LORD, forevermore' frame divine-cosmic-sovereignty in sanctuary-stability.
preamble.notable_variants: 93:1 'the LORD reigns' (YHWH malak / ho kyrios ebasileusen) enthronement-formula; 93:3–4 'the floods have lifted up … the LORD on high is mightier' as chaos-waters-under-divine-sovereignty theology.

variant_notes: 'The LORD reigns; he is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed; he has put on strength as his belt. Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved' tracks MT. 'THE LORD REIGNS' (YHWH malak / ho kyrios ebasileusen) — the enthronement-formula opening Pss 93, 95–99. Revelation 11:15 ('the kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ'), Revelation 19:6 ('the Lord our God the Almighty reigns') Christologically extend.
'Your throne is established from of old; you are from everlasting' tracks MT. PRE-ETERNAL-THRONE — divine-rule predates creation.

'The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring' tracks MT. FLOODS-LIFTED-VOICE — three-fold intensification of the cosmic-waters' challenge. The primordial-chaos imagery.
'Mightier than the thunders of many waters, mightier than the waves of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty!' tracks MT. DIVINE-POWER-OVER-WATERS. Mark 4:39's Jesus-stills-the-storm Christologically.
'Your decrees are very trustworthy; holiness befits your house, O LORD, forevermore' tracks MT. HOLINESS-BEFITS-YOUR-HOUSE — sanctuary-sanctity eternity.
